mapper.select: SELECT p.fk_Org_Level AS orglevel, pp1.person_num AS personnum, pp2.qulif_num AS qulifnum, (pp2.qulif_num / pp1.person_num) AS qulifrate FROM fw_person_info p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p1.fk_Org_Level AS org_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.f_ID) AS person_num FROM fw_person_info p1 WHERE p1.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY p1.fk_Org_Level ) pp1 ON p.fk_Org_Level = pp1.org_level LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p2.fk_Org_Level AS org_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.f_ID) AS qulif_num FROM fw_person_info p2 JOIN fw_person_qualification qulif ON qulif.f_IsDel = 0 AND qulif.fk_Person_ID = p2.f_ID WHERE p2.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY p2.fk_Org_Level ) pp2 ON p.fk_Org_Level = pp2.org_level WHERE p.f_IsDel = 0 GROUP BY p.fk_Org_Level
